description: Divisional Secretariat - Mahiyanganaya  - Esala Festival of Mahiyangana will be commenced on the 22.08.2017
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to the administration and regulations for the Mahiyangana Esala Festival, including camp area specifications, permitted commercial activities, vehicle restrictions, and sanitation requirements. It is issued under the Pilgrimages Ordinance and the Transfer of Powers Act by the Divisional Secretary. The content does not involve government structural/personnel changes (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any of the specialized categories (4-9) as it primarily concerns cultural/religious festival administration, making it fall under Miscellaneous (Type 10).
